about_the_game:
It was an era where the New Cold War loomed over the world, a time where the tiniest spark would have been all it took to tip the balance and start something ugly.

It was then that the giant cube suddenly appeared in the sky.

What followed was quick and deadly. Global superpowers mistook it as an escalation, and soon, civilizations crumbled under nuclear warheads.

Several decades passed. When the last survivors finally mustered up the courage to resurface, the cube that was still hovering in the sky swallowed them whole.

The cube proved to be a two-edged sword.

Those who survived it came back with everything they needed to keep on surviving, while most never returned.

As it is, you are left with two options.

Will you face the cubes, or will you simply perish?

<The Versatile Worlds of Cubes>

The cube in THE CUBE, SAVE US is made up of 27 versatile pieces or fragments.

Each time you pass a cube gate, the surroundings and mutants get shifted to keep you on edge.

Be it downtown, a pyramid, an amusement park... You will need to find weapons and escape routes to protect you in unpredictable circumstances.

<Fight and Survive>

As soon as you enter the cube, you will find yourself being targeted by vicious mutants and fellow raiders, the latter group doing what they do to survive—much like you.

Use everything you know about close combat to fight and to survive.

Utilize skills, especially in critical moments.

Remember. Too much sparing of skills and supplies can get you killed.

<The Raiders' Lair: New Cinderfall>

In 'New Cinderfall' a settlement founded by raiders who escaped the injustices of rangers, people with stories cheer on as raiders head toward the cube.

Interact with them to learn how to better survive, to unveil the secrets hidden across the post-apocalyptic world.

Why is the cube here?

Why did the Cube appear in this world? And what does the Cube truly desire?

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content

short_description: THE CUBE, SAVE US is an action-packed, close-combat extraction game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Pass each of the cube gates that presents its own surroundings and monsters. Survive the mutants and fellow raiders in close combat and come out on top by escaping the cube.
